verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an API quickstart that goes from an API key to agent, placed call, and transcript (bolna-docs-14, bolna-docs-23), and agent create/update APIs (bolna-docs-2). An official Go CLI manages agents, calls, phone numbers and batches with "no dashboard tab required" (bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24), and an official MCP server connects Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients to the account (bolna-docs-17, bolna-docs-25). Some setup still points to the dashboard: API keys are created there (bolna-docs-15), and provider and telephony integrations are connected under Settings → Integrations (bolna-docs-28). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching a number to an agent via API/CLI/MCP, the list of tools the MCP server exposes, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), dashboard-free API key and provider setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
